name: @observer/detectors
description: Observer observe-only detectors. Pure functions over normalised events; no I/O, no mutation, no model calls.
scriptsComment: typecheck borrows @types/node from packages/rig until these packages get their own devDeps. TEMPORARY: pnpm strict isolation means a package with no node_modules cannot resolve @types/node. Fix by adding typescript+@types/node as devDeps here and running pnpm install, once packages/rig is no longer mid-flight.
